title: DnB, electro and house / techno / trance kit
description: Drum and bass (liquid, neuro, jump-up, halftime; synthesised amen-style and think-style breaks and chops, reese, neuro, sub), electro (electro-funk 808 kit, vocoder-style leads, electro house filtered bass and pumped supersaw stabs) and house / techno / trance / big room (four-on-the-floor, rolling bass, plucks, supersaw chords, trance gate, arrangement maps) as racks, atoms, tension grammar and seven feel templates, generated by tools/concepts/build.mjs; plus the dnb-electro tutorial track presets.

ingredients.title: DnB, electro and house track demos
ingredients.description: Track demos: DnB tutorial, electro, house / techno / trance / big room (the paste-ready standalone programs)

ingredients.title: DnB, electro and house racks
ingredients.description: Chain-only hook defs: dnbKick, dnbSnare, ghostSnare, breakKick, breakSnare, ride, dnbShaker, dnbHat, dnbSub, reese, neuroBass, rollingBass, jumpWobble, liquidRhodes, liquidPad, strings, vocalChop, boom808, clap808, hat808, open808, cowbell808, electroBass, vocoLead, robotStab, filterBass, sawStab, houseKick, bigKick, houseClap, offHat, closedHat, houseBass, rumble, pluck, bigChords and 2 more

ingredients.title: DnB atoms
ingredients.description: glyphcore/dnb-electro drum-and-bass atoms (dnb.): two-step kick and snare, ghost notes and accents, amen-style and think-style breaks, chop orders for .bite(16, ...), shaker and ride, sub, reese, neuro, rolling and wobble lines, liquid chords, strings and vocal chops; gates of the 128-bar DnB form (intro, build, drop1, breakdown, build2, drop2, halftime, outro, drops, builds, vacuum).

ingredients.title: Electro atoms
ingredients.description: glyphcore/dnb-electro electro atoms (el.): electro-funk 808 kick, clap, hats and cowbell, synth bass, robot lead line and vowels, stab rhythm and chords; electro house kick, clap, offbeat hat, filtered bass line, stab rhythm, clap build and its velocity ramp; gates of the 40-bar electro form (intro, build, drop, break, drop2).

ingredients.title: House / techno / trance atoms
ingredients.description: glyphcore/dnb-electro house, techno, trance and big-room atoms (hs.): four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hat, 16th hats and accents, clap, rolling and offbeat bass, rumble, pluck arp, chords, trance gate, big-room lead motif; gates of the 56-bar house example (intro, groove, breakdown, build, drop, drop2, outro) and of a 160-bar club map in 32-bar blocks (mapIntro .. mapOutro, phrase8 ends).

ingredients.title: Feel: Liquid DnB
ingredients.description: Feel template "Liquid DnB" (172-176 bpm): rolling two-step with ghost notes behind the beat, shaker, held sub, liquid pad and vocal chops. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Neurofunk
ingredients.description: Feel template "Neurofunk" (172-176 bpm): machine-tight two-step, rolling ghosts, 8th hats and a 16th neuro riff (add a sub lane on atoms.feel.bass with dnbSub). Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Jump-up
ingredients.description: Feel template "Jump-up" (172-176 bpm): bouncy two-step pushed slightly forward, a wobble bass with octave jumps. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Electro house
ingredients.description: Feel template "Electro house" (126-130 bpm): four-on-the-floor, offbeat hat, filtered saw bass and supersaw stabs on the offbeats. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Driving techno
ingredients.description: Feel template "Driving techno" (128-135 bpm): four-on-the-floor, offbeat ride, 16th hats with accents, rolling bass in the kick's gaps. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Uplifting trance
ingredients.description: Feel template "Uplifting trance" (136-140 bpm): four-on-the-floor, offbeat bass, pluck arp and trance-gated supersaw chords. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Big room
ingredients.description: Feel template "Big room" (126-130 bpm): stripped drop: a big kick, a clap, an offbeat hat and one lead motif. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).
